from tinydb import TinyDB
from tinydb.storages import MemoryStorage
class CountingStorage(MemoryStorage):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.closes = 0
    def close(self):
        self.closes += 1
db = TinyDB(storage=MemoryStorage)

db.drop_tables()

print('drop_tables_ok')
db2 = TinyDB(storage=CountingStorage)
s2 = db2.storage
with db2:
    pass
print('exit_closes', s2.closes)
assert s2.closes == 1
print('drop_tables_exit_ok')
